name: Shred the Evidence
storyline: The Dunmore & Pratt Holdings company has hired you for the nightshift to destroy twelve case files before dawn breaks and the auditors arrive. Close the case before the audit and start the next night with double pay.
summary: A clicker game where you must shred every document from the twelve case files you're given before dawn breaks and the auditors arrive. You put folders, sticky notes, cards, and even gold bars, through a shredder machine that, if not careful, can overheat.
